name: PACE Yourself
tagline: What a body can afford today, and why.
description:
PACE Yourself explains the science of infection-associated chronic illness (IACI) in plain words, with every claim labeled by how well-established it is. IACI covers long COVID, ME/CFS, post-treatment Lyme disease syndrome, and related post-infection conditions.

Pause, Attune, Care, Engage: the four moves of pacing, the one intervention with real evidence behind it, explained the way it actually works in a body, not the way a wellness ad wants it to sound.

Educational material, not medical advice.
